letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai whispers your name, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad carries your laughter.  As the calendar flips to this beautiful spring, I’m reminded how our love, sealed on that unforgettable 23 Feb 2025, still feels brand‑new each day. You are my compass, my comfort, my endless adventure. Thank you for filling my world with warmth, mischief, and the sweetest moments. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or city streets we roam,  
Your smile turns every place to home.  
Together we dance through rain or sand,  
Forever bound, hand in hand.
